label: default branch: npm's Dependabot updates lose target-branch
old:
- package-ecosystem: npm
    directory: /
    schedule: { interval: weekly }
    target-branch: dev

label: default branch: the mutate job doesn't need resolve
default branch: the mutate job checks out dev by name
default branch: resolve's length check accepts any non-empty hex
default branch: resolve reads main's head on a schedule
default branch: resolve uses github.sha on a schedule
default branch: resolve's step id no longer matches its output
default branch: resolve's step skipped by a step-level if
default branch: suite-ci runs with resolve failed (if: always())
default branch: a new job with a commented header and no needs
new:
extra: # new
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: { ref: "${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}", persist-credentials: false }
  # Every property at 50,000

label: default branch: a Dependabot entry written directory-first, no target-branch
new:
updates:
  - directory: /
    package-ecosystem: pip
    schedule: { interval: weekly }

label: default branch: resolve's step runs under sh (dash), so [[ is not found
default branch: uv's Dependabot entry repeats target-branch as main
old:
- package-ecosystem: uv
    directory: /
    schedule: { interval: weekly }
    target-branch: dev
new:
- package-ecosystem: uv
    directory: /
    schedule: { interval: weekly }
    target-branch: dev
    target-branch: main
